title: Scans show a second Grand Gallery inside the Great Pyramid

tellings.quote: looks like there's a second Grand Gallery above it uh within within the pyramid. That shows up in scanning.

plain: Scans of the Great Pyramid in Egypt are said to show what looks like a second Grand Gallery, a copy of the tall sloping passage inside, sitting above the first one. The writer Graham Hancock mentions this without naming a source. He sees it as a sign that the pyramid still hides large unknown spaces.
